description: Send one prompt to a configured local Ollama model or, with explicit consent and GEMINI_API_KEY configured, Google Gemini API. Returns an observation ready for EdGEO visibility analysis. Provider API output is not equivalent to a consumer AI app or Google AI Search result; no citations are assumed.

consentToExternalRequest.description: Must be true to send a prompt to the external Gemini API. Not needed for Ollama loopback.

name: edgeo_query_model
title: Collect one AI model answer
